caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, yellow-green container with a hinged lid, decorated with a painted scene around its side. The primary scene shows a horse-drawn carriage with three visible wheels and a coachman holding a whip, sitting at the front. The carriage is pulled by a pair of pinkish horses in motion. Inside the coach are two figures visible through the window, both wearing hats. The background of the scene includes green trees with dark trunks, and two large, light-red or pink buildings with windows and doors; there are also three human figures standing outside the buildings, dressed in long coats and hats. The top of the container features painted landscape elements including trees and a large building in the center. The color palette is dominated by yellows, greens, pinks, and browns, with outlines and finer features rendered in darker shades. The painted design encircles the side of the container and also decorates the lid’s border.
title: Bandbox Design - Stagecoach
